derivation.method: Remove provider PBR materials and textures; Validate mesh; weld coincident vertices; dissolve degenerates; recalculate normals; collapse decimation only when above target with validation between passes; triangulate and validate before measuring. Remove wire edges, split edges shared by more than two faces and remove zero-area faces (counts in quality.topology_repairs). Never subdivide to inflate counts.

captured_generation.dimension_basis: Real-world sizes chosen for this import, not the stylised scene sizes: soft seat 0.90 m high (a lounge chair with a tall round backrest; also the height Project Y2K v061 used), bladder tank 0.45 m (a portable collapsible water container with a carry handle; Y2K v061 used 1.35 m and the Ginkgo scenes were larger still), canister 0.65 m (sized as a portable extinguisher-type pressure canister; Y2K v061 used 1.25 m). Each mesh was scaled uniformly to that height; width and depth were measured after scaling. Not a physical survey.
